title: The Hobbit The Lord of the Rings

vibeProfile.oneLine: Bilbo's adventure and the epic quest to destroy the One Ring.

summary: This volume gathers J. R. R. Tolkien's beloved Middle-earth saga: The Hobbit, in which the home-loving Bilbo Baggins is swept into an adventure to reclaim a dragon's hoard, and The Lord of the Rings, the epic quest to destroy the One Ring and unmake the dark lord Sauron. Drawing on a lifetime's invented languages, myth and history, Tolkien created the modern fantasy tradition almost single-handedly. Sweeping, warm and endlessly imagined, it is one of the most loved and influential works of the twentieth century.
whyReadIt: The book that created modern fantasy, a whole world with its own languages and history. Sweeping, warm and endlessly re-readable.

funFacts.text: Tolkien, a professor of language, invented whole tongues like Elvish before writing the stories to give them a home.
